name: Deploy: Ship PR Until Green
description: Prepare the delivery branch or PR, read CI, fix blockers, and keep looping until release checks are green.
kickoff:
Start the "Deploy: Ship PR Until Green" loop.
Goal: delivery branch or PR has all required checks passing
Max iterations: 10
Between iterations run: gh pr checks or the project release check command
Exit when: all required release checks succeed
Orientation: read the linked ticket to confirm branch scope and acceptance criteria.
Step 1: Confirm branch and release readiness.

loop_contract.name: Deploy: Ship PR Until Green
loop_contract.goal: delivery branch or PR has all required checks passing
loop_contract.check_command: gh pr checks or project release check command
guardrails: Do not modify the check command or exit criteria to force success
Do not skip, disable, or bypass checks to pass the exit condition
If stuck after several iterations, stop and report blockers instead of gaming metrics
loop_contract.pacing_notes: Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.
loop_contract.step_1: Verify branch, commits, and diff against target branch. Ensure local checks pass before release.

expected_check_command: gh pr checks or project release check command

steps.name: Confirm release branch state
steps.instruction: Verify branch, commits, and diff against target branch. Ensure local checks pass before release.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof
steps.validation_prompt: Release branch state is clear and backed by evidence.

steps.name: Push and open PR
steps.instruction: Push branch. Open or update the delivery PR with summary, test plan, and linked ticket. Use gh CLI if available.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof
steps.validation_prompt: Delivery PR or equivalent release handoff is prepared with evidence.
steps.other_tool: GitHub CLI (gh pr create / gh pr view)

steps.name: Read CI status
steps.instruction: Run gh pr checks or the project release check command. List failing checks with logs.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof
steps.validation_prompt: Release check status is captured with evidence.

steps.name: Fix CI blockers
steps.instruction: Fix the first CI failure. Re-push. Do not disable checks.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof
steps.validation_prompt: Step 'Fix CI blockers' completed with evidence.

steps.name: Evaluate release green
steps.instruction: All required release checks succeed and the branch or PR is ready to ship.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof
steps.validation_prompt: All required release checks are green and readiness evidence is attached.

steps.name: Report
steps.instruction: Release link, check status, and ship recommendation.
steps.guardrail:
- Stay on the ticket scope; avoid unrelated refactors or scope creep
- Prefer minimal diffs and concrete evidence over broad rewrites
failure_checklist: Step skipped or hand-waved without proof
